Khirki Mosque

A 90-minute heritage walk in Khirki, Delhi

Made for your group

  • Your day and start time, weekends and special days included
  • Any group size, from one person to a whole class
  • Your pace and your language: English, Hindi or both

Monument and museum entry fees, where charged, are paid at the site.

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you understand enclosed mosque planning and Jahanpanah urbanism.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Mosque exterior
  • Courtyard and roof logic
  • Vaulted interior, if accessible
  • Residential edge

How the time is spent

  1. Mosque exterior 15 min

    Introduce Khirki mosque and unusual plan.

    You: sketch footprint

  2. Courtyard and roof logic 30 min

    Discuss covered/open space and light.

    You: find ventilation strategy

  3. Vaulted interior, if accessible 30 min

    Compare structural bays.

    You: elevation sketch

  4. Residential edge 15 min

    Explain urban change and risk to monuments.

    You: note conservation questions

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Khirki Mosque using material evidence and a site map.
  • Understand enclosed mosque planning and Jahanpanah urbanism.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Khirki, Delhi
For
Schools, colleges, the public and private groups
Length
About 90 minutes
When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.
Led by
A historian or archaeologist who specialises in Delhi's buildings
Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
